result.title: Feedforward Novel View Synthesis for Heterogeneous Cameras
result.summary: Feed-forward novel view synthesis has recently shown promising results from sparse posed images, but most existing methods assume that context and target views share a fixed camera family. This homogeneous-camera assumption breaks in practical multi-sensor systems, where perspective, fisheye, and panoramic cameras may coexist and where the target projection may be unseen during training. We study feed-forward NVS across heterogeneous central cameras and identify a key ambiguity introduced by tokenization: a visual token aggregates a projection-dependent bundle of pixel rays, while existing camera encodings mainly expose absolute rays or token-center relations. To address this, we combine token-center relative Camera Positional Encodings and proposed local raymaps, a token-level representation that explicitly describes the intra-patch ray distribution summarized by each token. We further propose projection-aware 2D RoPE, which replaces raw image-grid coordinates with ray-induced angular coordinates so that relative positional reasoning is aligned across camera projections. Together, these components treat diverse cameras as calibrated samplings of a shared ray space rather than separate visual domains. On ScanNet++ with heterogeneous-camera system, our method improves over camera-conditioned baselines under mixed-camera evaluation and demonstrates zero-shot generalization to panoramic views.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究异构中心相机（透视、鱼眼、全景）下的前馈新视角合成，指出视觉 token 聚合的是一束与投影相关的像素射线，提出 token 级 local raymaps、token 中心相对相机位置编码与投影感知 2D RoPE，将不同相机统一为共享射线空间的采样。
AI.relevance_reason: 非 LVR 主线，但其「token 内射线分布」这一显式几何表示可能供核查：视觉 token 的投影相关性与内容如何在内部状态中保留、不同视角输入下位置编码是否对齐，对研究视觉细节留存和 latent 位置/视角结构或有借鉴价值。
